_provenance.what: The naming layer of the nine grahas from the one local source edition that carries it, the Bṛhat Parāśara Horāśāstra (corpus/bphs/canon.json, sa.wikisource witness; corpus/bphs/sanskritdocuments.json, the second witness): colours, deities, avatāras, iconography, Vedic mantra pratīkas, japa counts, and the time measures and seasons the text gives each graha. Built 2026-10-08 (the owner: 'add the Purāṇas and Upaniṣads from which the time ladder and names were built').
_provenance.order: Every list in these verses runs 'sūryādīnām krameṇa' / 'kramād arkādi-kheṭānām': Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rāhu, Ketu. Where a verse gives a list without naming each graha, the assignment by that order is the verse's own rule.
_provenance.quotes: 'sa' is verbatim from the verse named in 'from' (corpus/bphs/canon.json#chapter.verse, or …/sanskritdocuments.json#chapter.verse for the second witness). Words are the verse's; the IAST stems in the per-graha fields are this repository's reading of them [reading]; no translation of an edition is copied.
_provenance.navagrahaStotra: The Navagraha Stotra has no edition in any repository: it is recorded only as the owner's statement (registry OWNER-navagraha-units) with its derived witnesses, awaiting edition.
_provenance.tags: [text] the verse states it; [reading] this repository's reading of the verse's words; [standard] a convention no local text states; [claim-only] code or derived prose with no local source; [owner-statement] the owner's attribution, no local edition.

colour.note: the verses name each graha (divādhīśa, niśākara, kuja, budha, guru, śukra, raveḥ putraḥ); Rāhu and Ketu are not in them

quote.sa: सूर्यादीनां खगानां च देवा ज्ञेयाः क्रमेण च

assumptions.text: 'śacikā' is read as śacī (Venus) and ka (Saturn), the seventh name the list needs; the words are the verse's, the split is a reading

avatara.witnesses: the sa.wikisource witness (canon.json) lacks Mars's avatāra word in 2.5; the sanskritdocuments witness reads 'नृसिंहो भूमिपुत्रस्य'
avatara.note: the verses name the grahas (sūrya, candra, bhūmiputra, somasuta, vibudhejya, bhārgava, bhāskaraputra, saiṃhikeya, ketu)

images.height: 108 of the image's own aṅgula ('śatam aṣṭottaram')

iconography.note: no dimension of a chariot or a distance is given; the Sun's seven-horse chariot here is the only local text of it (no Purāṇic chariot is local)

quote.sa: आकृष्णेन इमं देवा अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत् ।

assumptions.text: the nine pratīkas are given to the grahas in the verses' order; the verses name no Vedic locus and none is supplied here

quote.sa: सप्त रुद्रा दिशो नन्दा नवचन्द्रा नृपास्तथा ।

japa.decode: bhūtasaṅkhyā, first word the units, × 1000 ('sahasraghnāḥ'); sapta, rudra, diś, nava, candra, tri and aṣṭa have these values in the SS's own register (corpus/surya-siddhanta/numbers.json); nanda (9), nṛpa (16) and pakṣa (2) are not in that register [standard]
japa.witnesses: both BPHS witnesses read the same words (corpus/bphs/wikisource.json and sanskritdocuments.json, 84.19-84.20)

finding.what: Ketu's count is 'saptacandrāḥ' = 17 by the units-first rule, so 17,000; sphuta serves 7,000 for Ketu (the other eight agree)

timeMeasure.note: the one local text that ties grahas to measures of time — the nearest local counterpart of the owner's 'Navagraha → time ladder'; it gives no ratios (corpus/sources/time-units.json)

quote.sa: चन्द्रस्य वर्षा विज्ञेया शरच्चैव तथा विदः

kalapurusha.note: the rāśis from Meṣa are the limbs of Viṣṇu in the form of time: the nearest local text of the Purāṇic picture of time

navagrahaStotra.statement: the owner's synthesis: some units (and the grahas' names) from the Navagraha Stotra

derivedWitnesses.what: the nine graha cards, each with one stotra verse; cited 'नवग्रह-स्तोत्र (व्यास)' at museum.html:3395

navagrahaStotra.variants: the two witnesses differ in small ways (Maṅgala: 'शक्तिहस्तं च' in sphuta against 'शक्तिहस्तं तं' in museum.html; 'सङ्काशं'/'संकाशं', 'दधिशङ्ख'/'दधिशंख')
navagrahaStotra.units: the nine verses as the witnesses give them name no unit of time and no number
navagrahaStotra.upgrade: when a printed edition of the stotra is added to corpus/, each verse is recorded here at its verse number as [text]; until then no verse number is given
